title: Grace & Courtesy Theater
shareTitle: Grace & Courtesy Theater — Kind Choices Take the Stage
description: Dress Poppy and Coco, choose one of six cozy felt-puppet stories, and help kindness take the stage through welcoming, asking, thanking, turn-taking, listening, and repair.
learningGoals: Read facial expressions and story props before choosing a social response
Practice welcoming, asking, gratitude, waiting, listening, and repairing after an accident
Connect kind words with concrete actions that help both friends feel safe and heard
interactionModel: choose a theater story, customize two felt puppets, then tap one of three illustrated social actions
feedbackModel: gentle narrated rewind for misses; expressive puppet pose change, felt-heart transformation, stars, and a curtain-call celebration for kind choices
